sections.content: scroll-snap-type on a container + scroll-snap-align on children creates carousels and paged scrollers that settle on items instead of stopping mid-way.
mandatory vs proximity: mandatory always snaps (can trap users), proximity snaps only when close — prefer proximity for accessibility.
Key points: works on any scroll container, combine with scroll-behavior: smooth, and test keyboard scrolling.
